assets.name: Universal Base Characters
assets.description: The Universal Base Characters Kit includes 6 game-ready character models in Superhero, Regular, and Teen proportions (male and female). Designed with optimized, animation-friendly topology and rigged with a Humanoid rig allowing easy retargeting in any engine. Mix and match 20 hairstyles, the Source version includes shaders to customize eye and skin colors allowing hundreds of unique combinations.

attribution.notice: CC0 asset by Quaternius; credit is appreciated.

assets.name: Zombie Apocalypse Kit
assets.description: The Zombie Apocalypse kit is here! 4 Playable characters, 20 animations each, 4 enemies, and best of all 2 DOGS. Plenty of environmental and vehicle models as well. In FBX, OBJ, glTF and Blend formats, free to use in personal and commercial projects.
